{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter for control arm and moderate severity
control_moderate = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute response fraction
n_control_moderate = len(control_moderate)
n_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_control_moderate

print(f"Number of control-arm, moderate-severity patients (deduplicated): {n_control_moderate}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction who responded: {fraction_responded:.4f}")"}
